guide.title: Jupiterseek Human Guide
guide.subtitle: A practical internal map for direct inspiration and loving discernment.

metaFrame.orientation: The chart is treated as a symbolic map of participation in a living cosmos: a pattern of correspondence, conscience, and choice rather than a verdict about fate.
metaFrame.wisdomTeacherFrame: Jesus is held here as a wisdom teacher of compassion, forgiveness, and direct inner alignment, alongside the perennial invitation to receive inspiration directly and test it through love.

overview.title: Living Cosmos
overview.body: This guide reads Sun in Leo, House 10; Moon in Scorpio, House 1; Mercury in Cancer, House 9; Venus in Leo, House 10; Mars in Aquarius, House 4; Jupiter in Aries, House 6; Saturn in Scorpio, House 1; Uranus in Sagittarius, House 2; Neptune in Sagittarius, House 3; Pluto in Scorpio, House 1; Asc in Libra; MC in Cancer as correspondences between inner life and visible choices. The working source grammar is correspondence between visible pattern and invisible life; participation in a larger order rather than isolated selfhood; the crossing of vertical inspiration with horizontal action. The aim is not to become more mechanical about the self, but more awake inside it: notice the pattern, ask what it serves, and choose a practice that makes the wisdom usable.
sourceBasis: The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
overview.practice: Name one chart fact that feels alive today, then choose one action that honors it.

overview.title: Heart and Direction
overview.body: Sun in Leo, House 10 points toward visible purpose, while Moon in Scorpio, House 1 asks for emotional honesty. Let the public path serve the private truth, so ambition becomes service rather than self-protection.
sourceBasis: Sun, chart ruler, MC, and 10th-house placements
The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
overview.practice: Before committing, ask whether the visible choice keeps faith with the inner need.

overview.title: Direct Inspiration
overview.body: Asc in Libra sets the threshold, and Mercury in Cancer, House 9; Uranus in Sagittarius, House 2; Neptune in Sagittarius, House 3 shows how insight becomes language. Return to simple words before making the signal grand; the truest vibration should become kinder, clearer, and more practical when it enters speech.
sourceBasis: The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
overview.practice: Capture the spark in one sentence, then test it through one concrete practice.

root.name: Root
root.practice: Name the need before solving it.
root.mantra: I can be steady with what I feel.
sourceBasis: The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
root.guide: Root is the ground-wire of the map. Moon in Scorpio, House 1; Mars in Aquarius, House 4 asks the reader to let instinct become honest presence. In the source lens of correspondence between visible pattern and invisible life; participation in a larger order rather than isolated selfhood; the crossing of vertical inspiration with horizontal action, this chamber is where inspiration descends into breath, boundary, and felt truth. The gift is emotional truth; the distortion is defensive retreat. Practice it as a return, not a punishment: Name the need before solving it.

heartChamber.name: Heart Chamber
heartChamber.practice: Offer warmth with a clear boundary.
heartChamber.mantra: Love works best when it stays honest.
sourceBasis: The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
heartChamber.guide: Heart Chamber is the covenant of affection. Venus in Leo, House 10 shows where warmth wants to become visible without becoming performance. Read through correspondence between visible pattern and invisible life; participation in a larger order rather than isolated selfhood; the crossing of vertical inspiration with horizontal action: love is not a mood but a tested alignment between attention, reciprocity, and boundary. The gift is generous connection; the distortion is performing for approval. Let the mantra hold the measure: Love works best when it stays honest.

voiceAndMind.name: Voice and Mind
voiceAndMind.mantra: My mind can make the signal usable.
sourceBasis: The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
voiceAndMind.guide: Voice and Mind is the translator. Mercury in Cancer, House 9; Uranus in Sagittarius, House 2; Neptune in Sagittarius, House 3 carries signal from feeling into language, study, and choice. Through correspondence between visible pattern and invisible life; participation in a larger order rather than isolated selfhood; the crossing of vertical inspiration with horizontal action, the mind is not asked to dominate mystery; it is asked to make the signal usable. The gift is clear translation; the distortion is scattered interpretation. Begin with the simple version first.

crownAndStar.name: Crown and Star
crownAndStar.practice: Choose the role that matches the work.
sourceBasis: Sun, chart ruler, MC, and 10th-house placements
The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
crownAndStar.guide: Crown and Star is the visible lamp. Sun in Leo, House 10; Venus in Leo, House 10; MC in Cancer describes how identity, vocation, and recognition can become service. The source lens of correspondence between visible pattern and invisible life; participation in a larger order rather than isolated selfhood; the crossing of vertical inspiration with horizontal action keeps visibility from hardening into vanity: the higher light must become a generous role. The gift is confident presence; the distortion is chasing recognition. Choose the role that matches the work.

shadowGate.name: Shadow Gate
shadowGate.practice: Work the hard pattern in small reps.
shadowGate.mantra: I can meet pressure without becoming it.
sourceBasis: Saturn, Mars, South Node, hard aspects, 8th-house, and 12th-house placements
The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
shadowGate.guide: Shadow Gate is the pressure chamber, not the enemy. Mars in Aquarius, House 4; Saturn in Scorpio, House 1; Moon & Mars square names where defense, fear, or control may gather. Read through correspondence between visible pattern and invisible life; participation in a larger order rather than isolated selfhood; the crossing of vertical inspiration with horizontal action: the hidden pattern is met so it can be redeemed into practice. The gift is disciplined courage; the distortion is control under stress. Work the hard pattern in small reps, with forgiveness as the heat.

serviceGate.name: Service Gate
serviceGate.practice: Define the service before the audience.
serviceGate.mantra: My work can be useful without consuming me.
sourceBasis: Sun, chart ruler, MC, and 10th-house placements
The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
serviceGate.guide: Service Gate is where the inner map becomes bread for the world. Sun in Leo, House 10; Venus in Leo, House 10; MC in Cancer asks what contribution can be offered without turning usefulness into self-worth. Through correspondence between visible pattern and invisible life; participation in a larger order rather than isolated selfhood; the crossing of vertical inspiration with horizontal action, service is the practical altar: inspiration made visible as a loving action. The gift is responsible contribution; the distortion is usefulness as self-worth. Define the service before the audience.

inspirationGate.name: Inspiration Gate
inspirationGate.practice: Capture the spark, then test it in practice.
inspirationGate.mantra: Inspiration becomes real when I translate it.
sourceBasis: The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
inspirationGate.guide: Inspiration Gate is the receiving station. Mercury in Cancer, House 9; Uranus in Sagittarius, House 2; Neptune in Sagittarius, House 3 shows how future signal, intuition, and language arrive. The source lens of correspondence between visible pattern and invisible life; participation in a larger order rather than isolated selfhood; the crossing of vertical inspiration with horizontal action asks that vibration be tested by embodiment: if it is true, it becomes kinder, clearer, and more useful. The gift is inventive perspective; the distortion is restless abstraction. Capture the spark, then test it in practice.

paths.medicine: Slow down, name both needs, and choose one grounded next action.
sourceBasis: The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
paths.guide: Moon and Mars form a path of square asks for conscious integration. Read it as a living polarity, not a defect. Choose the medicine gently: Slow down, name both needs, and choose one grounded next action.

practices.title: Root Practice
practices.body: Begin with Moon in Scorpio, House 1; Mars in Aquarius, House 4. Notice the need before solving it, then return to the body and breathe until the next honest choice is simple. The root is not proof of limitation; it is the place where inspiration learns to become embodied.
sourceBasis: The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
practices.practice: Name the need before solving it.

practices.title: Shadow Practice
practices.body: Work with Mars in Aquarius, House 4; Saturn in Scorpio, House 1; Moon & Mars square without fear. The task is not to defeat the shadow, but to forgive what defended you and choose a cleaner response. Pressure becomes wisdom when it is met without worshiping it.
sourceBasis: Saturn, Mars, South Node, hard aspects, 8th-house, and 12th-house placements
The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
practices.practice: Work the hard pattern in small reps.

practices.title: Service Practice
practices.body: Let Sun in Leo, House 10; Venus in Leo, House 10; MC in Cancer serve something real. Ask what contribution can be offered without turning usefulness into self-worth. This is the practical altar: a loving action that makes the inner pattern visible.
sourceBasis: Sun, chart ruler, MC, and 10th-house placements
The Symbolism of the Cross (source:perennial, source:contemplative)
practices.practice: Define the service before the audience.
